anchors.description: Diameter of the basketball resting on the office chair, measured between its left and right silhouette edges through the ball center.
anchors.visible_evidence: Orange ball with black seams leaning against the black leather chair; left and right silhouette edges visible against the dark chair and white paper stack.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Assumed a men's size 7 regulation basketball (circumference 29.5 in, diameter about 23.9 cm); could be a size 6 youth ball (about 22.6 cm).

anchors.visible_evidence: Black metal desk frame front-left leg meets the wood floor near the bottom of the frame; the desk top's left front corner is clearly visible above it.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard office desk height (28-30 in); exact model unknown, a taller writing table cannot be excluded.
